source: Humio Ichimura and Hiroki Sumida, On the Iwasawa lambda-invariant of the Real p-cyclotomic Field, J. Math. Sci. Univ. Tokyo3(1996),457–470
exact_read_scope: Setup and definitions printed457–461, including g_chi((1+p)^(1-s)-1)=L_p(s,chi), distinguished P_chi and X_alpha,n,Y_alpha,n.
Theorem and both corollaries on461 visually read from the primary PDF; both power tests are NON-membership, not membership.
Entire Section4 proof printed465–467 read; page467 additionally visually read to resolve extracted missing negations.
Supporting statements of Lemmas1–3 on462–465 read in retrieved text; their earlier foundational cited proofs are imported, not freshly re-proved.

theorem_scope.character: Any Qp-valued nontrivial even character of Gal(Q(mu_p)/Q); this includes a character of order5.
theorem_scope.one_root: For a Qp root alpha of P_chi, T-alpha does not divide char(A_infty(chi)) iff (c_chi,n)^(Y_alpha,n) is not a p^(n+1)-st power in K_n^times for some n.
theorem_scope.all_roots: Corollary1 needs every root of P_chi to lie in Qp and one such power test for each root.
theorem_scope.finite_witness: Corollary2 replaces the nonpower test by a nonpower residue at some degree-one auxiliary prime ideal.

application_limitations: The base class bound |A0|<=p does not compute P_chi, prove its roots lie in Qp, or verify the cyclotomic-unit nonpower tests.
The conclusion is lambda_p(chi)=0; no base-class vanishing conclusion is part of this theorem.
The finite-field nonpower condition must not be silently replaced by complex nonzero or a local unit norm statement.
No new order-five component has been removed and no main-gate movement is claimed.
extraction_warning: The PDF text extraction omits several not-in/not-subset signs. The primary page461 theorem and page467 proof were visually checked; retain the images IS1996-05.png andIS1996-11.png.
